Mode.Name: Mobile client
Mode.Hint: Load the lightweight character sheet instead of the full tabletop. On automatic, Phonedry loads on touch devices such as phones and tablets, and stays out of the way everywhere else. Changing this reloads the page.

Rolls.BadFormula: That formula could not be rolled. Try something like 2d6 + 3.
Rolls.Failed: Phonedry could not roll {what}. See the console for details.

HitPoints.Failed: Phonedry could not apply {what}. See the console for details.
HitPoints.NeedAmount: Enter how many hit points first.

Rotate.Message: Turn your phone upright to use the character sheet.

Empty.Heading: No character to show
Empty.None: No character is assigned to {user}, and you do not own one in this world. Ask your GM to assign you a character.
Empty.Ambiguous: You own more than one character and none has been assigned to you, so Phonedry does not know which to show. Ask your GM to assign one of these:

Spells.AddFailed: Phonedry could not add that spell. See the console for details.
Spells.Failed: Phonedry could not use {what}. See the console for details.
Spells.MoreResults: Showing {shown} of {total}. Keep typing to narrow it down.
Spells.NoList: No spell list is available for this character's class.
Spells.NoneBodyAdd: This character has no spells yet. Tap Add spells to choose some.
